decision: Reject before environment execution and do not submit, promote or claim performance.

temporary_package.result: static smoke passed; not an official Linux/container or driving evaluation

static_rejection_reasons: A repeated identical entry frame disarmed the entry phase on the second frame, alternating the outside request with the inherited inward preview.
The registered maximum0.035 line correction did not bound candidate-versus-control steering because entry replaced the inherited +0.05 preview; the observed request delta was0.08168.

Modified lateral steering fed the inherited abs(steering)>0.28 longitudinal safety branch, so gas could differ even when final rate-limited steering matched control, contradicting the frozen longitudinal contract.

A line-transition marker was armed from a pre-slew request and could zero internal steering on the next opposing obstacle even when the request was not emitted, allowing an action-to-action steering jump above0.07.
Writing arbitrary line requests into the existing exact-preview marker mixed responsibilities and could alter later obstacle transitions.
The visible half-width calculation used an inclusive pixel count, allowing a nominal7-pixel target to have only6.5 pixels of geometric edge distance.
Clear confirmation counters were not reset on every non-clear transition.
follow_up: A separately preregistered v2 may correct only these static contract defects without changing the lateral targets or using environment feedback.
